facts.fact: The Ministry of ICT's post of 2026-07-10 reports the Minister presenting to senators at a workshop on ratifying the Malabo Convention, the Budapest Convention and the Tampere Convention, and speaks of the benefits of ratifying them, so Eswatini had not yet ratified the Malabo Convention.

note: The SADC ministers, Eswatini among those attending, urged member states in general to consider ratifying the African Union Convention; it states nothing about Eswatini's own signature or ratification.

facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list updated 02/02/2026 shows Eswatini (no. 49) with no date of signature, ratification or deposit for the Malabo Convention, which entered into force on 8 June 2023; 21 states have signed and 20 have ratified.
